description: This file defines an internal interface ILocalClientDirectory within the Orleans.Runtime.GrainDirectory namespace, providing methods for local lookup operations related to Grain addresses.

classes.name: ILocalClientDirectory
classes.description: An internal interface for local client directory operations, including lookup methods for grain addresses.

methods.name: TryLocalLookup
methods.description: Attempts to lookup grain addresses locally, returning a boolean indicating success and the list of addresses if found.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of grain addresses for a given grain ID.
